{{Short description|none}}
This is a list of the best known [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] [[mathematician]]s. This list includes some [[Poland|Polish]], [[Russian Empire|pre-revolutionary Russian]] and [[USSR|Soviet]] mathematicians who lived or worked in [[Ukraine]].
